nina: Quick check - staging linkcheck flagged a broken link in docs/handbook/runtime.md pointing to /runtime/batching which now lives at /runtime/batching-overview.
paul: thanks, can you paste the failing URL?
nina: here's the snippet from linkcheck: `404 GET /runtime/batching -> docs/handbook/runtime.md: line 78`
paul: I moved that section earlier this month. I can add a redirect entry and a tiny PR for the doc update.
ci-bot: lint-run #409 reported linkcheck failure on branch docs/runtime-cleanup 
paul: plan: 1) add redirects.yml entry from /runtime/batching -> /runtime/batching-overview 2) update the inline link to the canonical path 3) add a changelog bullet.
docs-bot: note: redirects should be recorded in docs/REDIRECTS.yml and include original path and target.
nina: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/987 
paul: left a small suggestion to use an absolute path with the base (/docs/runtime/batching-overview) to avoid staging-relative surprises.
nina: updated PR, CI requeued. ci-bot queued lint + linkcheck for PR 987.
paul: pinging for quick CR @linda for doc wording and @simon for redirect sanity. Should be fast.
ci-bot: PR 987 linkcheck passed on re-run.
linda: reviewed - wording tweak: change "batching strategy" to "request batching strategy" for clarity.
paul: applied nit, merging after CI green.
docs-bot: reminder: add a one-line changelog to docs/CHANGELOG.md under "Runtime".
nina: will smoke-test the staging page after merge and flag if anything else pops up.
paul: thanks all. small wins. :tada:
